user.title: Connect your Terrestream
user.description:
On your device, open Setup → Home Assistant → Pair and enter its eight-digit code. The code expires after two minutes.

If you already use MQTT or the Terrestream cloud integration, follow the migration guide before choosing an existing history.

data_description.host: For example, 192.168.1.50. Discovery fills this in automatically.
data_description.legacy_source: Choose New setup unless you have prepared your previous entities for migration.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check Wi-Fi and open a new pairing window on the device.
error.invalid_auth: Pairing failed. Check the displayed code and try again.

abort.invalid_discovery: Discovery did not include a device identity.
abort.cannot_connect: The discovered endpoint could not be authenticated.

controller_conflict.title: Another Home Assistant controller is active
controller_conflict.description: Stop duplicate or restored Home Assistant instances, wait one minute, then reload this integration. If ownership has changed, disconnect and pair again using the device display.

offline_removal.title: Finish disconnecting the removed device
offline_removal.description: Home Assistant could not confirm that the removed device erased its pairing. On that device, open Setup → Home Assistant → Disconnect and confirm. Removing an offline entry does not revoke a copied backup token.

migration_incomplete.title: Finish migrating measurement history
migration_incomplete.description: Setup paused to protect your existing entity IDs and history. Check the integration setup error, follow the migration guide, then reload this integration. Do not delete your old entities or recorder statistics.

export_preferences.name: Export preferences
export_preferences.description: Export display preferences without credentials, identity, or cloud sharing policy.

import_preferences.name: Import preferences
import_preferences.description: Validate and save a complete preference profile as one operation.

pairing_revoked.message: Open a new pairing window on the device.

device_unavailable.message: Device unavailable during pairing confirmation. Check its Wi-Fi connection.

command_failed.message: The device did not confirm the change. Check its connection and try again.

busy.message: The device is busy. Wait for pairing, cleaning, or the update to finish, then try again.

revision_conflict.message: A setting changed on the device or in another app. Refresh the device, then try again.

storage_failure.message: The device could not save the change. Restart it and try again. Contact Terrestream support if this continues.

invalid_value.message: This value is not supported by the device. Check its allowed range or timezone name.

unsupported_setting.message: This firmware does not support that setting. Check for a firmware update.

unsupported_method.message: This firmware does not support that action. Check for a firmware update.

whole_number.message: Choose a whole number within the displayed range.

quiet_time.message: Enter a 24-hour time as HH:MM, for example 22:30.

approved_update.message: Only the firmware version offered by the Terrestream server can be installed.

loaded_device.message: Select a connected Terrestream Local device.

profile_unsupported.message: This firmware does not support preference profiles.

profile_invalid.message: Use a complete, unmodified preference profile exported from a compatible Terrestream device.

profile_unavailable.message: The device could not be reached. Reconnect it before exporting its preferences.

migration_cloud.message: In the old Terrestream integration, disable raw signals and reload it; its current roster must identify this device

migration_active.message: Disable the old device's measurement entities before migration; keep other MQTT devices and cloud insights enabled

migration_units.message: An old measurement has incompatible units or statistics; review it before migration

migration_duplicate.message: Duplicate measurement histories require a manual choice before migration

migration_owner.message: The old measurement has no integration owner

migration_missing.message: No compatible previous measurement entities were found for this device

migration_restored.message: Migration could not finish; previous entity ownership was restored
